final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT orderslink AS ref, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS gavg, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(gavg) AS savg FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref, s1.gavg, s1.cnt, s1.gavg - s2.savg AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.savg IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.gavg > s2.savg) SELECT AVG(gavg), AVG(cnt), AVG(diff) FROM s3
